# Recovered.org

> > Comprehensive addiction education and treatment resource covering substance abuse, withdrawal symptoms, and recovery pathways.

Recovered.org provides evidence-based information on prescription drugs (Adderall, Valium, Percocet), illicit substances (methamphetamine, crack cocaine, fentanyl), addiction neuroscience (dopamine reward systems), and treatment options including insurance coverage and medically supervised detox.

## Key Topics

- substance-abuse
- addiction-treatment
- withdrawal-symptoms
- drug-overdose
- opioid-addiction
- stimulants
- prescription-drugs
- fentanyl
- Schedule II controlled substances
- ADHD medications
- benzodiazepines
- detox-treatment
- dopamine and reward system
- drug-safety
- substance-dependence

## Understanding Addiction

- [Drug Classifications: Different Substance Categories](https://recovered.org/drug-classifications): Controlled Substances Act scheduling and drug category classifications
- [Warning Signs of Addiction](https://recovered.org/addiction/warning-signs-of-addiction): Physical and psychological addiction symptoms and diagnosis indicators
- [How the Brain's Reward System Fuels Addiction](https://recovered.org/addiction/dopamine-and-addiction): Dopamine neurotransmitter role in brain reward system and addiction cycles
- [Deadliest illicit and prescription drugs](https://recovered.org/addiction/dangerous-drugs): CDC data on deadliest drugs and overdose risks for illicit/prescription meds

## Stimulant Medications and Abuse

- [Adderall: Uses, Side Effects, Abuse, Addiction & Treatment](https://recovered.org/stimulants/adderall-amphetamine-dextroamphetamine): ADHD medication Adderall: prescription use, abuse risks, and withdrawal
- [Methamphetamine: Effects, Risks & Addiction](https://recovered.org/stimulants/meth-methamphetamine): Crystal meth effects, FDA Schedule II classification, and addiction risks
- [Dexedrine: Addiction, symptoms, detox and treatment](https://recovered.org/stimulants/dexedrine-dextroamphetamine): Dexedrine/dextroamphetamine Schedule II ADHD medication addiction treatment
- [Concerta (Methylphenidate) Withdrawal Symptoms](https://recovered.org/stimulants/concerta-methylphenidate/concerta-withdrawal-symptoms): Concerta Schedule II stimulant withdrawal timeline and detox treatment
- [How Long Does Meth Stay in Your System?](https://recovered.org/stimulants/meth-methamphetamine/how-long-does-meth-stay-in-your-system): Meth detection times, half-life, and drug testing methods (urine/blood)

## Opioid Medications and Treatment

- [Roxicodone: Uses, Effects, Addiction & Treatment](https://recovered.org/opioids/roxicodone): Oxycodone-based Roxicodone uses, overdose risks, and treatment options
- [Dilaudid (Hydromorphone): Addiction, withdrawal & treatment](https://recovered.org/opioids/dilaudid-hydromorphone): Dilaudid synthetic opioid painkiller dependence and withdrawal management
- [Detecting Fake Percocet: What Does It Look Like?](https://recovered.org/opioids/percocet/what-does-percocet-look-like): Counterfeit Percocet identification and fentanyl-laced pill safety risks

## Benzodiazepines and Sedatives

- [Valium Withdrawal: Symptoms, Timeline, and Detox](https://recovered.org/benzodiazepines/valium-diazepam/withdrawal-symptoms): Valium/diazepam Schedule IV withdrawal timeline and medically supervised detox
- [Rohypnol Side Effects: Abuse, Severity, and Overdose](https://recovered.org/benzodiazepines/rohypnol/rohypnol-side-effects): Flunitrazepam (Rohypnol) date-rape drug effects and overdose risks
- [Suvorexant (Belsomra): Uses, Doses, Effects, and Abuse](https://recovered.org/sleeping-pills/suvorexant-belsomra): Belsomra insomnia treatment: orexin antagonist dosing and side effects
- [Gabapentin: Is it a controlled substance?](https://recovered.org/other/gabapentin/is-gabapentin-a-controlled-substance): Gabapentin/Neurontin FDA regulation and state-level scheduling status

## Treatment and Insurance Support

- [Aetna Health Insurance Coverage for Addiction Treatment](https://recovered.org/insurance-coverage/aetna-drug-and-alcohol-rehab-coverage): Aetna insurance coverage for rehab under Affordable Care Act provisions

## Optional

- [Identifying Crack Pipes and Other Paraphernalia](https://recovered.org/stimulants/crack/crack-paraphernalia): Guide to identifying crack cocaine pipes, bongs, and smoking devices
- [How Crack Cocaine is Made](https://recovered.org/stimulants/crack/how-is-crack-made): Crack cocaine manufacturing process, cutting agents, and fentanyl risks
- [What is the Street Value of Xanax? The cost of addiction](https://recovered.org/benzodiazepines/xanax-alprazolam/street-price-of-xanax): Xanax/alprazolam illegal market pricing and fake pill identification
